Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:10:1.english: Who is not suited - [She is] disqualified for him.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:10:2.hebrew: כופתו - הלוקה בב"ד, כופתין שתי ידיו על העמוד במסכת מכות (דף כב:). כופתו — קושרו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:10:2.english: Binds him - [Regarding] one who receives lashes in court, they bind his two hands to the pillar, [as taught] in tractate Makkot (daf 22b). "Binds him" [means] ties him.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:10:3.english: Straps him - Lashes him with a strap.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:10:4.english: And concerning all of them - Priests, Levites, and Israelites.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:10:5.hebrew: אליהו כותב - מאי דקאמר ואזיל: "אוי לו לפוסל זרעו ולפוגם את משפחתו", כגון שנשא אשה שאינה הוגנת לו. (האי אליהו לאו אליהו דכתיב במקרא הוא, דא"כ, מקמי דהוה אתי מאן כפתיה? אלא שם מלאך הוא, שהוא סופר למעלה):
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:10:5.english: Elijah writes - [He writes] that which [the text] goes on to say: “Woe to him who disqualifies his offspring and who blemishes his family” — for example, where he married a woman who is not suited for him. (This Elijah is not the Elijah who is written in Scripture, for if so, before he came, who bound him? Rather, it is the name of an angel who is a scribe on High.)

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:11:1.hebrew: כל הפוסל - מגדף תמיד את המשפחות, הוא עצמו פסול. ואינו מדבר בשבחה לעולם — אין דרכו של פסול לדבר בשבח הבריות לעולם:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:11:1.english: Anyone who disqualifies - [One who] constantly disparages families, he himself is disqualified. And “he never speaks in praise” — it is not the way of a disqualified [person] to ever speak in praise of people.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:12:1.hebrew: נטר עד דשקיל שמעיה דרב יהודה - המתן עד שיטול שלוחו של רב יהודה, שעומד כאן ליטול:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:12:1.english: Wait until the servant of Rav Yehuda has taken - Wait until the agent of Rav Yehuda takes, who is standing here to take [it].

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:12:2.hebrew: בר שויסקל - לשון גנאי: גרגרן, אוכל שויסק — צלי — כדאמר בפסחים (דף צו.) באימורי פסח מצרים: ״מאן לימא לן דלא שויסקי עבדינהו?״ — בשם רבינו הלוי:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:12:2.english: Bar Sheviskel - A derogatory expression: a glutton who eats shevisk — roast [meat] — as it says in Pesachim (daf 96a) regarding the sacrificial portions of the Passover-offering in Egypt: “Who is to say to us that they did not make them into sheviski [roasts]?” [This was explained] in the name of Rabbeinu HaLevi.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:12:3.english: He excommunicated him - As we find that they excommunicate for the honor of the master in Moed Katan (16a).

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:12:4.hebrew: אמרו ליה - לרב יהודה: רגיל ההוא גברא דקרי לאינשי עבדי:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:12:4.english: They said to him - To Rav Yehuda: That man is accustomed to calling people slaves.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:13:1.english: Before Rav Huna - To consult with him whether he should go before Rav Naḥman.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:13:2.hebrew: לא מיבעי לך למיזל - לפני רב נחמן, שאתה גדול ממנו. ואתה ראש בפומבדיתא, ורב נחמן ראש בנהרדעא ודיין לראש גלותא וחתניה דבי נשיאה, כדאמרינן בהעור והרוטב (חולין דף קכד.): משום דרב נחמן חתני' דבי נשיאה הוא, מזלזל בשמעתיה דר' יוחנן:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:13:2.english: You are not required to go - Before Rav Naḥman, for you are greater than he. And you are the head in Pumbedita, while Rav Naḥman is the head in Neharde'a and a judge for the Exilarch, and the son-in-law of the house of the Nasi [the Exilarch], as we say in [the chapter entitled] Ha'or Veharotev (Chullin 124a): "[Just] because Rav Naḥman is the son-in-law of the house of the Nasi, does he disparage the teaching of Rabbi Yochanan?"

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:13:3.english: The honor of the house of the Nasi - For he was the son-in-law of the Nasi.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:14:1.hebrew: אסור לעשות מלאכה בפני שלשה - שגנאי הוא ושפלות לדור שכפופים לזה, שאין לו מי שיעשה מלאכתו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:14:1.english: He is prohibited from performing labor before three [people] - For it is a disgrace and a humiliation for the generation, who are subservient to this [leader] who has no one to do his work.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:14:2.english: Degundarita - That is [the word for] a parapet in one of the languages.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:14:3.hebrew: מי סני - כלומר, מכוער ושנוי לשון תורה ולשון שאר בני אדם, שאתה מדבר בעמקי שפה? ומתכוין היה רב יהודה לתופסו בדבריו לקנטרו, להודיעו שלא היה לו להנשא עליו להזמינו לפניו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:14:3.english: Is it distasteful - That is to say: Is the language of the Torah and the language of other people repulsive and despised, that you speak in obscure language? And Rav Yehuda intended to catch him in his words to provoke him, to make known to him that he should not have exalted himself over him to summon him before him.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:15:2.hebrew: תילתא ברמות רוחא - מתוך ששליש רוחו גסה, הוא משנה בדיבורו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:15:2.english: One-third in haughtiness of spirit - Because one-third of his spirit is haughty, he alters his speech.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:15:3.hebrew: אנבגא - כוס שהוא רביעית. והיו רגילין לשתות כוס אחד ממשקה העשוי לשתותו שחרית, וקוריהו אספרגוס במסכת ברכות (דף נא.):
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:15:3.english: Anbaga - A cup that is a revi’it [in volume]. And they were accustomed to drink one cup of a beverage prepared to be drunk in the morning, and they call it ispargus in Tractate Berakhot (51a).

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:15:4.hebrew: אנפק - כוס של רביעית, ולשון אנפק היה שגור בפיהם:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:15:4.english: Anpak - A cup of a revi'it, and the term anpak was fluent in their mouths.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:16:1.hebrew: תיתי דונג - תבא בתי, שכך שמה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:16:1.english: Let Donag come - Let my daughter come, for that is her name.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:16:2.english: One may not make use of a woman - So that one does not accustom her to be familiar among men.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:16:3.english: She is a minor - Rav Naḥman said this.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:17:1.english: To Yalta - The name of his wife.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:17:2.hebrew: קול באשה ערוה - שנאמר: ״השמיעני את קולך״, ואם אשאל בשלומה, תשיבני:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:17:2.english: A woman’s voice is nakedness - As it is stated: “Let me hear your voice” [Song of Songs 2:14]; and if I inquire after her welfare, she will respond to me [and I will hear her voice].

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:17:3.hebrew: אמר ליה רב נחמן - אפשר לשלוח לה שאילת שלום ע"י שליח:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:17:3.english: Rav Naḥman said to him - It is possible to send her greetings through a messenger:

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:1:1.hebrew: לא תאכל - ואפילו זרע אין לה ושבה אל בית אביה, חוזרת לתרומה ואינה חוזרת לחזה ושוק:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:1:1.english: She may not eat - And even [if] she has no offspring and returns to her father’s house, she returns to [eating] teruma, but she does not return to [eating] the breast and thigh.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:3:1.english: To Shecaniah the son of Arah - He was an Israelite.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:4:1.hebrew: ותו ממאי דהוו להו בני - לטוביה ולבנו מנשים הללו, מבת שכניה ומבת משלם:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:4:1.english: And furthermore, from where [do we know] that they had children - [That is, to] Tobiah and to his son from these women, from the daughter of Shecaniah and from the daughter of Meshullam.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:4:2.hebrew: ותו ממאי דהוו להו בני - לטוביה ולבנו מנשים הללו — מבת שכניה ומבת משלם:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:4:2.english: And furthermore, from where [is it known] that they had children - [That is,] to Tobiah and to his son from these women — from the daughter of Shecaniah and from the daughter of Meshullam.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:4:3.hebrew: ותו - אפי' היו להם, ממאי דמבבל עלו אותם נשים ובניהם? דילמא בארץ ישראל נותרו בימי גדליה אותם שכניה ומשלם, ושם נשאו טוביה ובנו את בנותיהם. (ולא יכלו להגיד בית אבותם וזרעם אם מישראל הם — היינו שתוקי ואסופי):
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:4:3.english: And furthermore - Even if they had [children], from where [is it known] that those women and their children ascended from Babylonia? Perhaps those [men], Shecaniah and Meshullam, remained in the Land of Israel in the days of Gedaliah, and there Tobiah and his son married their daughters? (And [the verse], “And they could not tell their father’s house and their seed, whether they were of Israel,” that refers to a shetuki and an asufi.)

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:5:1.hebrew: למעשה סדום - שהיו מגלי עריות, דכתיב (בראשית י״ג:י״ג): ״רעים וחטאים״ — ״רעים״ בגופם, ״וחטאים״ בממונם. ואמרינן בחלק (סנהדרין דף קט:): דמחי לאתתא דחבריה ומפילה, א"ל: ״תהוי גבך עד דמעברא״ — הרי ממזרים לגבי ישראל:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:5:1.english: To the act of Sodom - For they engaged in forbidden sexual relations, as it is written (Genesis 13:13): “wicked and sinners” — “wicked” with their bodies, and “sinners” with their money. And we say in [chapter] Chelek (Sanhedrin 109b): [If one] strikes his fellow’s wife and causes her to miscarry, they say to him: “Let her be with you until she becomes pregnant” — behold, [there are] mamzerim among Israel.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:6:1.english: Their fathers’ house - [This refers to] his father.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:6:2.english: And their offspring - [Refers to] his mother.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:6:3.hebrew: זה אסופי - דאילו שתוקי מכיר להודיע אמו שהיא מישראל, והכא לא ידעו אם מישראל הם:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:6:3.english: This is a foundling - For whereas a shetuki [one of unknown paternity] is able to make known his mother, that she is of Israel, here they did not know whether they were of Israel.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:6:4.hebrew: אמר אדון - מסרס המקרא ודריש: אדון כמו אדון, אימר כמו אמר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:6:4.english: The Master said - [He] transposes the verse and expounds: Addon as adon [Master], [and] Immer as amar [said].

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:6:5.english: Master - The Holy One, blessed be He.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:6:6.hebrew: ככרוב - קדושים ככרובי הקדש, כחיות הקדש, דכתיב ביה (יחזקאל י) ״פני הכרוב״:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:6:6.english: As a cherub - Holy like the holy cherubim, like the holy living creatures, concerning which it is written (Ezekiel 10): “The face of the cherub.”

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:6:7.english: As a leopard - Like this animal, which is not scrupulous about [mating with] the mate of its fellow.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:7:1.hebrew: כאילו חרשו כו' - משום דלא יכלו להגיד יחוסם, קרי להו תל מלח. חרשא — לשון חורש:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:7:1.english: As though he plowed [it], etc. - Because they could not declare their lineage, [the verse] calls them Tel Melach. [And] “Harsha” is an expression of plowing [ḥoresh].

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:8:1.hebrew: בנים זרים - מאשה פסולה לו, ולשם ממון נסבה, כדמסיים קרא: ״יאכלם חדש את חלקיהם״ — ממון שנשאה לשמו, יאכלם בחדש אחד:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:8:1.english: Strange children - [Born] from a woman who was unfit for him, and he married her for the sake of money, as the verse concludes: “A month shall devour them with their portions” — the money for whose sake he married her will be devoured in a single month.

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:9:1.english: And lest you say "his portion" - Such as guaranteed property [tzon barzel].

Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:9:2.hebrew: ולא חלקה - כגון נכסי מלוג, דהיא לאו איסורא עבדא, שחזרה לינשא למיוחס:
Rashi on Kiddushin 70a:9:2.english: And not her portion - Such as usufruct property, as she did not commit a transgression, in that she remarried [a man] of distinguished lineage.
